Evan Lee: Quick sync — proposing an incremental 'golden feeder' for onboarding new models. idea: ship minimal golden inputs + targeted perf probes so we can validate correctness + latency regressions before full bench run. thoughts?
Carla M.: I like the idea. can we make the feeder deterministic so it reproduces flaky outputs? maybe seed corpus + small prompt variations.
Dinesh: +1. also want to make sure KV cache warmup is covered. a single short prompt won't exercise cache behavior. suggest 3-5 prefixes with varying lengths.
Ben: question: how do we map feeder pass/fail to admit gate? do we require strict parity, or a soft signal to trigger full bench?
Evan Lee: leaning soft-signal. feeder should be a fast reject for obvious mismatches (e.g., tokenizer mismatch, shape errors, catastrophic output). if feeder passes, enqueue for full bench and extended validation.
Carla M.: agree on fast rejects. also propose a compact telemetry payload from feeder: {status, sample_ids, latency_p95, top_token_hash} — small JSON we can store on registry.
Dinesh: we should include a quick compatibility check for quantized binaries. simple run: load model with target qconfig and run 2 short inferences. fail if loader errors or outputs are NaN/inf.
Ben: ops question: how long should feeder run budget be? we can't block intake for >5 min. my suggestion: cap at 60s by default and allow overrides for manual review.
Evan Lee: 60s cap sounds reasonable. feeder should be preflight-only: no heavy profiling. bench continues async.
Carla M.: Implementation note: add a new API route /intake/feeder-run that returns immediately with feeder_id and status streaming. sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://registry.intake.local/intake/feeder-run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model_id":"m-123","qconfig":"int8-fast","timeout_s":60}'
```
infra-bot: feeder-run started for m-123 (feeder_id=ff-20260321-001) :progress: 0%
Dinesh: we need clear failure codes: LOADER_ERROR, TOKENIZER_MISMATCH, NUMPY_INVALID, LATENCY_SPIKE, OUTPUT_DIVERGENCE. makes triage easier.
Ben: also log nginx route + region tag so we can route retries to same infra if transient.
Evan Lee: tradeoffs: feeder reduces time-to-flag but increases surface area of early checks. maintainers will need clear signal docs. i'll draft a short RFC with API + failure codes + sample payloads.
Carla M.: Can you include a small matrix mapping feeder checks -> actions (reject, auto-escalate, allow-async)? that helped last time.
Evan Lee: yup, will draft. target: RFC by EOD Friday. :calendar:
Ben: if you want a quick reviewer from infra ping me. i can check the endpoint semantics and timeout handling.
Dinesh: i'll help define the golden input set generation heuristics. maybe we add a lightweight fuzzer later.
Evan Lee: thanks all. wrapping up: feeder = deterministic golden inputs + 3 prefix lengths + quantized loader smoke + 60s cap + small telemetry blob + clear failure codes. next: RFC link when ready.
Carla M.: :thumbsup:
